grant_camera_initial_instructions_firefo.message:
You're about to grant QRCraft access to your camera.

When asked whether to allow QRCraft to use your camera, please make sure the "Remember for all cameras" checkbox is checked, then click "Allow".

Click the button below to start.

grant_camera_initial_instructions_chrome.message:
You're about to grant QRCraft access to your camera.

When asked whether to allow QRCraft to use your camera, please choose "Allow while visiting the site".

Click the button below to start.

grant_camera_blocked_instructions_firefo.message:
It looks like QRCraft is blocked from using the camera.

To change this setting, click the icon on the left of the address bar, and remove the "Blocked" status on the "Use the camera" row.

After you've done that, refresh this page.

grant_camera_blocked_instructions_chrome.message:
It looks like QRCraft is blocked from using the camera.

To change this setting, click the icon on the address bar, and choose Always allow QRCraft - QR Code Generator and Scanner to access your camera.

After you've done that, refresh this page.

grant_camera_unusable_instructions_html.message:
It looks like the camera is inaccessible. Is there another program using the camera?

Please close other programs that might be using the camera, then refresh this page.

grant_camera_unknow_error_instructions_h.message:
An unknown error occurred when trying to acquire camera access.

Please refresh this page and try again.

grant_camera_granted_instructions_html.message:
QRCraft has been successfully granted permission to use the camera.

You may close this page now.

grant_page_dont_see_icon_btn_html.message: I can't find the icon!

grant_page_dont_see_icon_instructions_ht.message: Some browsers hide the icon afte a few seconds. Please click the button below to show it.

unable_to_access_camera.message: Unable to access the camera. Is there another program using the camera?

unable_to_access_camera_unknown_error.message: Unable to access the camera. An unexpected error occurred.

settings_scan_success_sound_enabled_expl.message: Play a beep sound when a QR code is successfully scanned.

settings_picker_pause_videos_onload_enab.message: Pause all videos during "Select region to scan"
This pauses videos while you're selecting a scan region, so you don't miss any QR codes.

settings_white_on_black_qr_ccode_in_dark.message: Generate white QR Codes on black background in dark mode

In dark mode, generate QR Codes with a light foreground color on a dark background. Some scanners may have trouble scanning such QR Codes. The QR code you save or copy via the "Save" and "Copy" buttons will always have a white background and black foreground.

settings_generator_defaults_explainer.message: These defaults are used whenever you create a new QR code. You can still override them per QR code from the generator's Options panel.

settings_theme_explainer.message: Choose whether QRCraft follows your system theme or always uses a specific one.

settings_motion_explainer.message: Control the animations and transitions used throughout QRCraft.

settings_history_max_items_explainer.message: Oldest entries are automatically removed once this limit is reached.

settings_reset_explainer.message: Restores appearance, generator defaults, and scanner options to their original values. Your scan and generate history is not affected.
